title: Block Out Level 19 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 19 is a basement-first numeric board. Open the lower red, green, black, and white stack first, then flatten the giant `20/10` cyan carpet, and spend the yellow roof only after the middle has softened.

landmarks: Block Out Level 19 is a basement-first numeric board.
Open the lower red, green, black, and white stack first, then flatten the giant `20/10` cyan carpet, and spend the yellow roof only after the middle has softened.
The board mixes Cyan, Blue, Yellow and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The giant cyan field only matters after the lower blockers have rotated.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Open the right side of the basement so the lower red and green pieces can start rotating.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel away the black and white blockers that are pinning the cyan carpet from below.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Leave the repeated `20/10` slabs mostly parked until the basement has become flatter.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the lower stack opens, start flattening the cyan carpet from the middle outward.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the top blue-and-yellow roof move only after the center slabs are no longer acting like one solid sheet.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Use the side counters to finish off the remaining cyan values.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: End with the last yellow roof pieces and the bottom red gate.

failurePoints: Treating the middle cyan carpet as the opening problem.
Leaving the basement stacked while trying to move the roof.
